posts.title: Skills vs Agents vs Prompts vs MCP: The 2026 Agentic Hierarchy
x_thread:
The #1 reason multi-agent systems fail in production is primitive confusion.

Teams build unbounded autonomous agents when all they needed was a 5-step skill.

Here is how Prompts, Skills, Agents, and MCP compose into a sovereign stack 🧵👇

1/ The 4-Layer Hierarchy:
• Layer 1 (Prompt): Ephemeral request (what to say once)
• Layer 2 (MCP): Universal JSON-RPC wire protocol (what the model can touch)
• Layer 3 (Skill): Version-controlled, evaluated recipe (how to do recurring jobs)
• Layer 4 (Agent): Stateful FSM loop pursuing a high-level goal
2/ If you remove the Skill layer, your agents improvise every run. If you remove MCP, your skills cannot touch real infrastructure securely.

3/ Decision Rule:
One-off idea? -> Prompt.
Recurring job? -> Write a SKILL.md.
External tool access? -> Build an MCP Server.
Dynamic path to goal? -> Deploy an Agent.

Full architectural breakdown, decision trees, and code schemas on FrankX:
https://frankx.ai/blog/skills-vs-agents-vs-prompts-vs-mcp

posts.title: AI Infrastructure & Hardware Economics: Blackwell, LPUs, and Sovereign AI Factories
x_thread:
Inference is the new manufacturing workload. Comparing GPUs purely on $/hr rental rates is flawed procurement.

Here is the truth about NVIDIA GB200 NVL72, Groq LPUs, Cerebras CS-3, and the real metric: Cost per Verified Outcome 🧵👇

1/ GPUs (NVIDIA Blackwell) are bandwidth and compute monsters built for massive batch processing and pre-training.

LPUs (Groq) and Wafer-Scale Engines (Cerebras) use on-chip SRAM to deliver 80 to 21,000 TB/s bandwidth and sub-15ms Time-to-First-Token.
2/ When an agent runs 15 multi-turn tool loops, 400ms GPU TTFT means a 10-second user delay. On an LPU, that same loop completes in 350 milliseconds.

3/ Enterprise procurement must optimize for:
Cost per Outcome = (Compute Cost/Hr × Latency) / Verification Pass Rate.

Hardware with higher deterministic completion rates is cheaper overall.

https://frankx.ai/blog/ai-infrastructure-blackwell-lpu-ai-factories-2026
